# Every

> > A publication exploring AI tools, coding workflows, and the future of work through essays, product launches, and interviews with builders.

Every publishes original writing from Dan Shipper, Alex Duffy, and other contributors on AI developments, while building AI-powered products like Spiral (writing partner), Sparkle (organizing tool), and Cora (development agent). The site covers everything from AI coding tools and agent workflows to startup strategy and product design philosophy.

## Key Topics

- AI agents and agentic workflows
- Spiral (AI writing partner)
- Sparkle (AI organizing tool)
- Cora (AI development agent)
- Claude and GPT model usage
- AI coding tools and developer workflows
- Dan Shipper and Alex Duffy (editors)
- OpenAI and ChatGPT developments
- Model switching and prompt engineering
- AI product design and UX
- Startup strategy and venture capital
- AI-assisted content creation
- Developer conferences and AI news

## Every's AI Products

- [Introducing Spiral v3: An AI Writing Partner With Taste](https://every.to/on-every/introducing-spiral-v3-an-ai-writing-partner-with-taste): Every launches rebuilt Spiral v3 for short-form content collaboration
- [How I Built Spiral](https://every.to/chain-of-thought/how-i-built-spiral): Dan Shipper's Claude chat transcript building Every's prompt builder
- [Making It Sparkle](https://every.to/on-every/making-it-sparkle): Announcing Sparkle AI organizing tool plus role prompting techniques

- [Why Is Jensen Huang $120 Billion Richer Than You?](https://every.to/napkin-math/why-is-jensen-huang-120-billion-richer-than-you): Evan Armstrong analyzes Nvidia's success beyond chips with Jensen Huang
